name: Izumiotsu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Izumiotsu city emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised device of two curved strokes and a small disc.
history: Municipal flag of Izumiotsu, a city in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 September 1942.

features.role: Izumiotsu city emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised device of two curved strokes and a small disc
